classification.summary: The customer wants to refund a premium listing payment made by mistake by one of his members and asks how to issue the refund from the admin panel.
questions: How do I issue a refund for a membership or listing payment from the admin panel?

outputs.body:
Hi Ravi,

Good news: you can refund this from your admin. Here are the steps:

1. Go to My Members » Search Members and find the tutor.
2. Click Actions, then Payment History. This opens the Transactions tab.
3. On the paid invoice, click Actions » Refund Payment.
4. Click "Yes, Continue" to confirm.
5. A "Refund Successful" pop-up appears, and the invoice moves to the Refunded tab (Finance » Transaction History > Refunded).

Check with your payment gateway before you start, because some gateways handle refunds differently:
- Some do not allow refunds from third-party sites like the admin.
- Some need a waiting period. Authorize.net needs 24 hours.
- Some have a time limit. PayPal allows 6 months.
- If you changed gateways after the payment, refund it directly in the original gateway account.
- With PayFast, the admin Refund button only updates the status in your records. It does not send money back. Request the refund from PayFast first, then mark the invoice as refunded.

If you tell us which gateway you use, we can tell you which of these applies. We have not looked at this payment ourselves, so we can't say whether it will go through. The account owner will review your request within 1 business day and let you know if anything else is needed.

The Lakeview team

evidence.question: How do I issue a refund for a membership or listing payment from the admin panel?
evidence.answer:
Refund a payment from the member's Payment History in the admin: open the member's Transactions tab and use Actions » Refund Payment on the paid invoice.

1. In the admin, go to My Members » Search Members and find the member.
2. Click Actions, then Payment History. This opens the Transactions tab.
3. On the paid invoice's row, click Actions » Refund Payment.
4. Confirm by clicking "Yes, Continue".
5. A "Refund Successful" pop-up appears, and the invoice moves to the "Refunded" tab (Finance » Transaction History > Refunded).

Before refunding, check with your payment merchant, because some gateways do not allow refunds, require a waiting period (for example, Authorize.net needs 24 hours), block refunds from third-party sites like the admin, or have a refund time limit (PayPal allows 6 months). If the gateway was changed after the transaction, refund it directly in the original gateway account. With PayFast, the admin Refund option only updates the status for internal records and does not send money back, so request the refund from PayFast first, then mark the invoice as refunded.

classification.summary: The customer asks how to change her directory site's language from English to Spanish and whether both languages can be offered at the same time.
questions: How do I change the language of my Brilliant Directories site?

outputs.body:
Hola Lucía:

Sí, se puede cambiar el idioma y también ofrecer los dos a la vez.

Para cambiar el idioma principal a español:

1. Ve a Settings » General Settings » Localization y elige el idioma en "Default Website Language".
2. Marca la opción "Use same language for text labels and email templates". Así el sistema traduce automáticamente las etiquetas de texto y las plantillas de email. Esto solo funciona si el idioma está en la lista de idiomas compatibles con traducción automática del sitio.
3. Traduce el menú del encabezado y el menú principal desde el Menu Manager, porque no usan etiquetas de texto.

Ten en cuenta que no todo se traduce automáticamente, así que parte del contenido habrá que actualizarlo a mano.

Para ofrecer inglés y español a la vez, usa el add-on Google Website Translator. Así cada visitante puede cambiar de idioma por su cuenta. Se activa en Settings » Design Settings » General » Header Design y aparece en el encabezado. Si quieres limitar los idiomas disponibles, edita translate_languages en Settings » Advanced Settings. Sin este add-on, el sitio tiene un solo idioma principal.

Si prefieres que lo configuremos nosotros, dínoslo y lo hacemos.

Un saludo,
The Lakeview team

evidence.question: How do I change the language of my Brilliant Directories site?
evidence.answer:
Change the Default Website Language under Settings » General Settings » Localization; for a multi-lingual site, add the Google Website Translator add-on.

1. Go to Settings » General Settings » Localization and select the Default Website Language.
2. Check "Use same language for text labels and email templates" so the system automatically translates text labels and email templates. This works only if the language is in the Supported Languages for Automatic Website Translation list.
3. Translate the header menu and main menu through the Menu Manager, because they do not use text labels.
4. If the language reads right to left, set the Advanced Setting "Text Direction" (text_direction) to "Right to Left".
5. Not everything is translated automatically, so some content will need manual updates.

classification.summary: Daniel wants to know the fastest way to bulk-import about 300 plumbing companies from a spreadsheet as directory members, and whether members can select more than one main category.
questions: How do I bulk import members from a CSV or spreadsheet in Brilliant Directories?
Can a member be assigned to multiple categories in Brilliant Directories?

outputs.body:
Hi Daniel,

Yes to both. Here is how each one works.

1. Bulk adding your 300 companies
Use the CSV import. Steps:
- Download one of the CSV import templates from the "How To Import Members Via CSV File" article on the Brilliant Directories support site and open it in Excel or Google Sheets.
- Do not change the spelling of any headers in row 1, or the import will fail.
- Rows 2 to 4 are explanations. The listing_type column accepts only Company or Individual. Delete rows 2 to 4 before importing, or they will be imported as members.
- Enter your member data in the correct columns, and delete any empty columns. That makes the file smaller and the import faster.
- Keep website, booking and social links in a full format like https://website.com, or they will be skipped.
- In My Members » Search Members, open the List Actions dropdown and choose Import Members via CSV File.

Two notes: Service Areas cannot be imported at this time. And if you use Google Sheets and the file goes over 2 million cells, split it into smaller files. 300 rows should be well under that.

2. More than one main category
Not quite. A member can only pick one Top Level Category. They can pick several Sub and Sub-Sub Categories, though.

The workaround is to create one General top-level category that holds all members. Then set up Plumbing, HVAC and the rest as sub or sub-sub categories. Members can then choose more than one from the Listing Details tab when they log in.

If you want top and sub category selection on one member form, that takes a few changes to the member forms. If subcategories do not show up, check that Member Specialties are enabled in the Post Publishing tab of the Membership Plan.

We can set up the category structure for you if you would like. Just tell us and we will take care of it.

The Lakeview team

evidence.question: How do I bulk import members from a CSV or spreadsheet in Brilliant Directories?
evidence.answer:
Members can be bulk imported with a CSV file: download a CSV import template, fill it in, and import it from the Import Members via CSV File option in the List Actions dropdown on the My Members » Search Members page. Steps from the passages:
1. Download one of the CSV import templates from the 'How To Import Members Via CSV File' article and open it in a spreadsheet application such as Excel or Google Sheets.
2. Do not change the spelling of any headers in row 1, or the import will fail.
3. Read the explanations in rows 2 to 4 (the listing_type column accepts only Company or Individual), then delete rows 2 to 4, otherwise they will be imported as members.
4. Enter the member data in the correct columns.
5. Delete any columns that are empty, which reduces file size and speeds up the import.
6. Keep URL fields (website, booking link, social) in a valid format such as https://website.com or https://www.website.com, otherwise they are skipped.
7. In My Members » Search Members, open the List Actions dropdown and choose Import Members via CSV File.
Notes: Service Areas cannot be imported at this time. If a file has more than 2 million cells, split it into smaller files when using Google Sheets.

Yes, you can. Switch the site to Staging Mode. Visitors to your domain will see a "Coming Soon" page while you keep adding restaurants.

1. Go to Settings >> General Settings and find the "General" section.
2. Click the Website Status dropdown and select "Staging Mode". The option is labeled "Staging Mode (shows pre-registration form on homepage)".

evidence.answer:

classification.summary: Daniel wants to know the fastest way to bulk-import about 300 plumbing companies from a spreadsheet as directory members, and whether members can be assigned more than one main category.
questions: How do I bulk import members into a Brilliant Directories site using a spreadsheet?
Can a member be assigned to multiple categories in Brilliant Directories?

outputs.body:
Hi Daniel,

1. Bulk adding members

Yes, you can import all 300 at once from a CSV file instead of typing each one. The import option is under My Members » Search Members, in the List Actions dropdown ("Import Members via CSV File").

To prepare the file:
- Download one of the CSV import templates from Brilliant Directories' import guide: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/5000558475-how-to-import-members-via-csv-file
- Open it in Excel or Google Sheets.
- Don't change the spelling of the headers in row 1, or the import will fail.
- Delete rows 2 to 4. They only explain what goes in each column and would otherwise be imported as members.
- Copy your data into the matching columns. In the listing_type column, use "Company" for your plumbing companies. The only other option is "Individual".
- Delete any empty columns. This makes the file smaller and the import faster.

A few things to know:
- Service Areas can't be imported.
- Website, booking and social links are only imported if they are full URLs, like https://website.com. Any other links are skipped.

The guide we have doesn't cover the upload steps themselves, or how to assign categories during the import. We'll check both and get back to you within two business days.

2. More than one main category

You're right. A member can only pick one top-level category. They can pick several sub and sub-sub categories, though, and there's a workaround that does what you need:
- Create one general top-level category that covers all members.
- Set up Plumbing, HVAC and your other trades as subcategories under it.
- Members then choose their categories and subcategories from the Listing Details tab when they're logged in.

This changes how your categories are organised, so it's worth planning before you import the 300 companies. If you'd like, we can talk through the setup with you first.

Best,
The Lakeview team

Go to My Members » Search Members and open the List Actions dropdown, which has an "Import Members via CSV File" option. 2. Download one of the CSV import templates from the reference article. 3. Do not edit the spelling of the headers in row 1, or the import will fail. 4. Rows 2 to 4 only explain what goes in each column, so delete them or they will be imported as members. In the listing_type column the only values are Company and Individual. 5. Enter the member data in the correct columns. 6. Delete any empty columns, which makes the file smaller and the import faster. 7. Open the file in a spreadsheet application such as Excel or Google Sheets. Notes: Service Areas can't be imported. URL fields (website, booking link, social, etc.) are only imported if they are valid URLs like https://website.com or https://www.website.com; otherwise they are skipped.

The Lakeview team
